hero.title: Ideas in code. Roots in Bucovina.
hero.summary: Five sections, one community of young people shaping the digital world. We meet in Suceava, Romania, in 2027.

about: ONTI brings together students passionate about technology, teachers, and communities from across Romania. The 2027 national stage will take place in Suceava, hosted by Colegiul Național „Ștefan cel Mare”.
dateUnknownNotice: The date has not been announced yet. Sign up for an email update and we will let you know when it is published.
contestDistinction: ONTI is Romania’s National Olympiad in Information Technology. It is distinct from the National Olympiad in Informatics (ONI), which has a different subject, format and ranking.
